flows.name: Agents work a semiconductor company's lifecycle, from design verification to production
flows.summary: The industry its home page puts in the spotlight. Emergence describes its approach as deterministic, formally verified and governed agent networks with persistent memory; the steps below are the ones the page names, not a full process.

steps.what: Works with Emergence above its existing stack and yield platforms.
Use their understanding of complex chip architectures and manufacturing processes across design verification and production.
steps.agent: Specialised agents, embedded with subject-matter expertise, span the lifecycle.

steps.what: Automate investigations, decisions and corrective actions, to find defects early, optimise yields and reduce time to market.
steps.agent: Investigate, decide and act on corrections.

steps.what: Focus on what matters most, with the workflows adapted to their teams' needs.
Keeps validated decisions and learned remediations in persistent memory, so each execution adds to the next.
